color/ink.$description: All text, all icons, all borders. Warm near-black — never pure #000.

color/paper.$description: The page. Solid — no gradients, no patterns, no ambient glow.

color/sand.$description: The second surface. Cards, list rows, wells, inset panels sit on paper in sand.

color/mango.$description: The accent. One per view. It means 'this is the next action'. Fill or 2px border only — never a gradient, never text.

color/sky.$description: Informational mark. Chart series, status dot, chip. Never a section background.

color/forest.$description: Success / positive mark. Also the scroll-to-top control on the live site.

color/grey.$description: Disabled state and non-semantic chart series.

color/ink-10.$description: Decorative hairline dividers and rules only. Deliberately below 3:1 — a divider is not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply to it. Never use this to outline a control.

color/ink-15.$description: Card and section outlines — decorative, alongside a surface-colour change that already does the work.

color/ink-30.$description: Placeholder text and disabled glyphs. NOT for focus rings or control borders — it measures 1.95:1 and fails WCAG 1.4.11.

color/ink-50.$description: Control borders and focus rings — anything whose visible boundary is the only thing identifying a component. 3.30:1 on paper, 3.21:1 on sand: clears WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 non-text floor on both surfaces.

color/ink-65.$description: Muted text — hints, timestamps, captions. 5.16:1 on paper, 4.98:1 on sand: clears WCAG AA body text on both surfaces.

color/mango-deep.$description: Mango hover/pressed only. Not a second accent.

color/sky-deep.$description: The INFORMATIONAL role — status dots, info banners, anything where sky carries meaning rather than decoration. Brand sky is 1.99:1 on paper: invisible as a status mark. 3.63:1 on paper, 3.31:1 on sand.

text/2xs.$description: Legal, captions in dense tables. Use sparingly.

text/sm.$description: BODY DEFAULT. The site's most common size by a factor of ten.

text/base.$description: Body in compact/app density, and lead-in paragraphs on web.

text/xl.$description: H3 / card title at web density.

text/4xl.$description: Display, hero. Serif, weight 300, negative leading.
